svg.title: Command map: scrutate's commands by family
svg.desc: Search without an index (grep, tsquery), search the index (search, find, grep --index, batch), code intelligence (symbol, callers, callees, refs, outline, deps, rdeps, similar, dupes, impact), maintenance (index, check, stats, languages, config, completions) and servers (serve, lsp, watch).
svg.text: // COMMAND MAP: SCRUTATE'S COMMANDS BY FAMILY
